title: Predict: Expectation Check
description: Practice coding reasoning while using AI. Compare your expectation with supplied code, explore optional explanations, and check a concrete input or requirement. You decide what to trust.

title: Eco.Coding
description: Notice avoidable work in your code. Understand the trade-off, preview supported changes, and apply or revert them yourself. Build resource-conscious habits through everyday practice.

title: Human Agency: Choice & Recovery
description: Review whether people can understand, choose and recover in your software; then test the real interaction.

title: RTL Viz
description: Interactive RTL schematics for Verilog and SystemVerilog, with code-to-graph navigation. Bundled Verilator (WebAssembly), no install needed.

title: Syncline Mesh
description: Edit the same files together in VS Code and Cursor. People who can see the GitHub repository join automatically. Connected agents coordinate overlapping changes for both people to accept.
